text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cheval, happy birthday! Diamond and<n>I have an
original song to present to<n>you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Your sisters entrusted us with the<n>important task of
throwing a big<n>celebration for you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So, I hope you enjoy. Cheval is<n>always super
serious. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Every day in class, her posture's<n>fabulous. ♪ Her
notes are so neat, the<n>teacher praises her on
repeat! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
At cleaning time, she's super serious<n>too. ♪ She
cleans every corner, every<n>spot and every speck
on the floor, so<n>it looks brand-new! ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And when we move classrooms,<n>she's the last
one there. ♪ Making<n>sure nobody's left anything
behind!<n>She's delightful, and so very smart,<n>and
kind! ♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
E-enough! I can't take any more of<n>this! I-I'm
going to explode!
